title: Duplicate TIDE columns are deterministically identical but not independently replayable
summary: Integrity/3 conservatively coalesces only duplicated TIDE Long/TIDE Short headers after exact cell-text equality across every parsed row. Two retained manifests report 41,239 compared rows per chart, zero conflicts and zero missing cells, with 41,238 bars admitted after trailing-bar exclusion. This supports structural admission for the two hashed files, but the raw files are not repository evidence, hosted workflow/status evidence is absent from the connected GitHub views, and no training or performance validation occurred.
net_new_delta: DUPLICATE_TIDE_HEADER_AMBIGUITY_IS_RESOLVED_FOR_TWO_HASHED_FILES_AT_THE_STRUCTURAL_LEVEL, BUT REAL_DATA_REPLAY, INDICATOR_PROVENANCE, HOSTED_VERIFICATION, AND MODEL_AUTHORITY_REMAIN_UNESTABLISHED.

strongest_quantitative_claim.statistical_interpretation: Deterministic within-file equality, not 82,478 independent samples and not evidence of predictive value.

falsification_result: FALSIFIED: duplicate TIDE headers necessarily imply conflicting feature values in these two hashed files. NOT FALSIFIED OR TESTED: the duplicated headers share valid indicator provenance, the TIDE features add predictive information, or parser-v3 admission improves held-out performance.
accepted_findings: The implementation compares every physical row before timestamp, OHLC, duplicate-bar or trailing-bar filtering.
Only selected TIDE feature duplicates may be coalesced; core time/price/volume ambiguity remains fail-closed.
Missing, textually non-identical, or conflicting duplicate cells block admission, including conflicts on rows later discarded.
The retained manifests preserve raw hashes, canonical-row hashes, exact column indexes and comparison counts.
rejected_or_unverified_findings: Reject interpreting 41,239 matching rows as an effective sample size or calibrated confidence measure; equality is deterministic for each file.
Hosted verification is unverified: the connected GitHub workflow-run and combined-status views returned no runs/statuses for source commit ceac2394... or merge commit becd8ef3....
The two raw chart exports are not committed, so repository-only reviewers cannot recompute the equality claim from source bytes.
Exact duplicate values do not establish indicator provenance, non-leakage, incremental predictive information, OOS performance, or trading authority.
estimator_validity: No statistical estimator is needed to establish exact equality inside fixed files. Any inference beyond those bytes requires a separate sampling/provenance model. Row count cannot be promoted into confidence.
data_sufficiency: Sufficient for structural equality of the retained hashes if the manifests are trusted; insufficient for independent replay because raw bytes are absent and provider-time/indicator-generation provenance is unattested.
multiple_testing_status: Not a performance-family test. Selection history for why only TIDE duplicates were eligible is documented in code but not a preregistered statistical family; no predictive hypothesis was tested.
redundancy_ablation_status: Duplicate TIDE columns contain zero incremental information relative to each other within the two manifests. Whether the coalesced TIDE feature adds information beyond price/volume or leaks target state is untested.
held_out_oos_status: No training executed and no held-out/OOS performance result exists. Realistic costs are premature and remain mandatory only if a predictive trading rule later survives.
maturity_change: Structural data-admission and manifest transparency increase. Indicator provenance, model, parameter, calibration, anomaly and performance maturity do not increase. Legacy parser receipts remain needs_requalification; DAEDALUS BLOCKING remains authoritative.
blockers: Raw chart bytes are absent from repository evidence, preventing independent replay against raw_sha256 values.
No accessible GitHub workflow runs or combined commit statuses support the event's hosted-verification statement.
Provider/export configuration and indicator-generation provenance for the duplicated TIDE columns are unattested.
No no-retune model rerun, TIDE-vs-no-TIDE ablation, purged temporal validation, untouched OOS block or realistic-cost result exists.
The Icarus-engine producer_contract.json path is absent; the readable Icarus contract and explicit task envelope were used.
next_decisive_experiment: First, independently replay integrity/3 against the exact raw_sha256-bound exports in an authorized evidence store and persist a verifier receipt that names raw blob identity, parser blob and canonical-row hashes. Then freeze one no-retune model specification and compare coalesced-TIDE versus TIDE-dropped datasets using purged temporal folds plus a final untouched contiguous OOS block. Treat duplicate copies as one feature; report leakage checks, dependence-aware uncertainty, the complete model/feature family, and realistic costs only if a trading rule survives.

evidence.observed: PR merged; body claims 26 local tests and requires hosted checks; connected workflow-run and combined-status views returned empty results.

aion.finding: Preserve parser-v3, raw hashes, canonical-row hashes and exact duplicate-column witnesses as a new structural state while retaining legacy parser receipts as needs_requalification; do not rewrite historical authority.

ascension.finding: Structural equality is supported by code and retained manifests, but raw-source replay and hosted-check claims are not independently verified through accessible repository evidence; Spine/interface visibility must not confer extra trust.

prometheus.finding: Research priority is an exact-byte independent replay followed by a preregistered no-retune coalesced-TIDE versus TIDE-dropped ablation on purged temporal folds and untouched OOS data.
